## Activity

During October 2023, Market Eye Clinic completed 397 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. The capture total should continue to be monitored alongside the quality and grading measures below, so that operational issues can be identified and followed up through the appropriate local processes.

## Image quality

A total of 84 captures were assessed as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 21.2. This result indicates that a substantial proportion of images could not be used for grading. The clinic should review the circumstances associated with ungradable images and ensure that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues consistently will support follow-up and help identify any continuing equipment or workflow concerns.

## Grading

Grading identified 66 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This measure should be reviewed with the monthly activity and image-quality findings to support oversight of the service. Continued attention to image acquisition, issue logging and grading timeliness will help the clinic maintain a clear view of operational performance.
